document.title: Fix the starship-6388 eval flake: unflagged generated output gets its own group
document.summary: The skill gets two grouping rules: generated output the CLI does not flag is mechanical and gets its own group, and a draft `mirrors-<n>` group merges with files that serve the same concern. The `.agents` copy is synced.
document.why: `starship-6388` fails on and off because the review puts `src/modules/vcs.rs` and `.github/config-schema.json` in one group, and the flake [hides real regressions](source:s1).

sources.title: Eval: starship-6388 fails intermittently (vcs.rs grouped with config-schema.json)
sources.gist: starship-6388 fails the apart check in about a quarter of main evals; done when it passes reliably.

sources.label: PR #179
sources.gist: Prompt-only fix; failing producers said they trusted the missing CLI mechanical flag.

lookFor: The ticket is done when `starship-6388` passes reliably [across repeated graded eval runs](source:s1). The PR proves it with 40 producer runs that use the deterministic checks only, with no grader; the graded suite runs after the merge to `main` [per the PR](source:s2).

groups.title: Generated output the CLI misses
groups.why: Failing producers put the schema with the code because the CLI did not flag it as generated [PR](source:s2).
groups.summary: The mechanical bullet in Grouping rules now makes generated output the CLI missed its own group when the diff shows the generator, with a summary that says whether the output matches the code at head.

attention.note: A file such as a checked-in schema now leaves the group of the code it comes from, so the reader checks it in a separate group. The rule fires only when the diff shows the generator or build step, so a hand-written schema with no such step stays with its story. Output that does not match its code must not get a skip summary.

groups.title: Mirrors groups merge with same-concern edits
groups.why: With the schema fixed, producers kept the draft fossil pair apart from `hg_branch.rs` and `pijul_channel.rs`, which call the same helper [PR](source:s2).
groups.summary: Step 3 now lets a draft `mirrors-<n>` group merge with files that serve the same concern with a different edit, and each repeated file's note names the file it repeats.

attention.note: A merged mirrors group loses its own read-one-skip-the-rest group. The repeat signal moves into the file notes, so the reader opens one group with mixed edits instead of two.

groups.title: Synced agent skill copy
groups.why: `pnpm sync:skill` writes `.agents/skills/` from `skills-next/`, and the pre-commit hook fails when they differ.
groups.summary: Generated copy of `skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md` with the same two edits; the reader can skip it.

commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Skill: unflagged generated output gets its own group; mirrors merge with same-reason edits
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The CLI misses some generated output, such as a checked-in schema that a derive writes. Producers trusted the missing mechanical flag and grouped starship-6388's config schema with the dispatcher. A draft mirrors group also stayed apart from files that call the same new helper with a different edit.

Fixes #177.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
